wholePhysicalScope: Masonry bridge registered to the original OpenStreetMap way 300791897. The cleared Qualla view and heritage record identify the road crossing above the former byewash.
lodDetails: All detail levels retain the flat slab, stone piers and abutments. Near levels add molded caps, edge trim and open safety rails.
limitations: The mapped endpoints set the span and heading. Deck width, pier spacing, surface colors and railing geometry are estimates based on the public-domain photograph and the single-lane context.
The original 5 m terrain field anchors the road approaches. Pier footing depth, deck height and the buried abutment faces are approximate.
